native.bitrate: Explicit underlying Ethernet baseline, no independent SC rate and no borrowed CAN rate.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded APDU unknown, no generic 8-byte default. Registered routing baseline NPDU 61327 minus minimum two NPCI octets; actual headers, options and peer maximum further limit it. Not BVLC 65535 or IP APDU 1476.
native.mtu_bytes: Explicit IPv4-over-Ethernet MTU 68..1500, proposal 1500. TCP segmentation allows larger SC messages; IPv6 needs its own explicit link profile.
native.duplex: Actual physical Ethernet mode unknown. Bidirectional WebSocket does not establish full-duplex PHY.
native.bacnet_device_instance: Assigned device instance 0..4194302, unknown actual identity, not VMAC or persistent UUID.
native.bacnet_max_apdu_bytes: Actual peer APDU property unknown; can exceed 1476 in SC. Registered routed baseline cap 61325, not actual capacity or certified device support.
native.bacnet_segmentation: Actual PICS transmission/reception capability unknown, not TCP segmentation.
native.bacnet_apdu_retries: Confirmed application service retry proposal 3, zero allowed; distinct from TCP and SC reconnect.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_modifiable: Unknown actual device writability selects conditional literature proposal.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_ms: Conditional literature default 3000 / 60000 ms; actual values preserved and required positive with retries.
native.bacnet_segment_timeout_ms: Literature 2000 ms proposal for supported APDU segmentation; not connect wait or heartbeat.
native.sc_connection_type: Required hub connection baseline HUB; optional DIRECT stays on same network and still needs hub connection. This selection describes a connection, not an entire node conformance proof.
native.sc_websocket_subprotocol: Hub and direct protocols differ. Conditional hub.bsc.bacnet.org / dc.bsc.bacnet.org; obsolete BACnet/IT asn identifier invalid.
native.sc_primary_hub_uri: Actual configured WSS hub URI unknown. Reject ws, malformed ports, fragments and credentials. RFC 6455 port 443 only if omitted, not a universal explicit BACnet port.
native.sc_failover_hub_uri: Optional actual WSS failover URI unknown, empty unconfigured allowed; not invented redundant hub.
native.sc_direct_peer_uri: Optional actual WSS direct URI unknown; hub URI is not a direct peer identity.
native.sc_vmac_kind: Actual EUI-48 versus Random-48 origin unknown.
native.sc_vmac: Actual six-octet individual virtual address unknown; zero and broadcast excluded; Random-48 first low nibble exactly 2. No generated address or collision proof.
native.sc_device_uuid: Actual RFC 4122 device UUID unknown; persistent across restarts and lifetime. Not random per form render or derived from BACnet instance.
native.sc_accept_direct_connections: Optional actual node-switch acceptance capability unknown, not falsely confirmed false.
native.sc_peer_max_bvlc_bytes: Actual announced uint16 BVLC receive limit unknown, <=65535. Entire message includes header/options/NPDU.
native.sc_peer_max_npdu_bytes: Actual announced uint16 NPDU limit unknown within registered routed 61327 baseline; not Ethernet MTU.
native.sc_npdu_bytes: Actual encoded NPDU unknown. APDU path includes at least two NPCI bytes; peer NPDU/BVLC limits checked separately.
native.sc_npci_header_bytes: Actual APDU-path NPCI length 2..21 unknown, routing adds destination/source addresses. No automatic two-byte header for routed traffic.
native.sc_bvlc_base_header_bytes: Actual base header 4, 10 or 16 depending on optional virtual addresses; excludes options. Unknown until encoded path is known.
native.sc_destination_options_bytes: Actual destination-option encoding unknown; zero must be explicit, not inferred from absence.
native.sc_data_options_bytes: Actual data-option encoding unknown; router support of 4192 octets is not mandatory overhead for every message.
native.sc_reconnect_timeout_modifiable: Unknown actual configurability determines fixed/configurable interval constraints.
native.sc_min_reconnect_s: No universal default. Lowest documented proposal 2 seconds if configurable, 10 if fixed; fixed range 10..30. Configurable support 2..300 is not a universal maximum; reconnect <=600.
native.sc_max_reconnect_s: Actual backoff algorithm bound unknown; standard ceiling 600 seconds, >=configured minimum. Vendor 300 is not universal default.
native.sc_connect_wait_s: Recommended standard default 10 seconds; mandatory configurable support covers 5..300, not universal upper bound 300. July 2020 errata corrects connect-wait terminology.
native.sc_disconnect_wait_s: Locally determined actual timeout unknown; no universal vendor 10-second default.
native.sc_heartbeat_timeout_modifiable: Unknown actual configurability; fixed and configurable minimum ranges differ.
native.sc_heartbeat_s: No universal default. Lowest baseline proposal 3 configurable / 30 fixed; fixed 30..300. Configurable support 3..300 is not universal maximum.
native.sc_accept_heartbeat_s: Actual accepting-peer inactivity limit unknown, not silently copied from its own initiating interval. Appropriate margin needs remote peer evidence.
native.sc_tls_version: Required-to-implement baseline TLS 1.3; optional PICS extensions need distinct profile, no auto TLS execution proof.
native.sc_mutual_tls_required: Mandatory mutual TLS requirement proposed true; false invalid. Does not confirm active peer certificate validation.
native.sc_cipher_suite: 2021 addendum cd mandatory capability TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; not an observed negotiated cipher or implicit old RSA requirement.
native.sc_signature_algorithm: 2021 cd mandatory ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256 capability, optional extra algorithms separate PICS.
native.sc_key_exchange_group: 2021 cd mandatory secp256r1 capability; no generated keys or active handshake.
native.sc_operational_certificate_ref: Actual operational credential reference unknown. No private key material; validity/expiry/revocation/direct CA signature require execution evidence.
native.sc_ca_store_ref: Actual site CA store reference unknown, not a global internet trust-store default. Certificate lifecycle is installation-specific.

removed.qos_priority: SC ignores network-layer priority at its datalink; Ethernet PCP is not an SC service priority.
removed.sync_method: PTP/NTP/gPTP not implicit SC capability or service guarantee.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal bandwidth reservation percentage in SC.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Native confirmed-service retry and reconnect controls replace generic retransmission flag.
removed.retransmission_rate: Probability does not describe actual TCP/APDU/SC state machines.
removed.retry_limit: Native APDU retry default 3, not generic zero.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: APDU timeout and SC reconnect timers have distinct native semantics.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: Generic 100 Mbit/s router throughput is unverified equipment evidence.
removed.vlan_id: Not an SC protocol field; explicit lower-link VLAN belongs to its own profile.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Generic Ethernet limiter not an SC transaction guarantee.
